source.rule: USERT in MaterielOperationalModes is relative to the overlying RBD level and multiplicative down an RBD path (manual physical p200). BASIC selects system mode G09-SER-OPS and its POS-B leaf G09-B-USE; PAR selects G04-OPS/USERT1 at both levels.

configuration.shared: Accepted G09.var04 controlled positive POS-A FRQ1e-9, POS-B FRQ600000 OPHOURS, BASIC series h8/h32, PAR active parallel h20, direct half-hour CM, one aircraft, seed1/replication1/horizon36. No changes to physical structure, mission schedule, base rates, stock, repairs, or RBD structure.
configuration.direct_half_control: Accepted use05 sets BASIC system USERT1 and BASIC POS-B USERT0.5; source-defined product0.5.
configuration.factorhalf: Set BASIC system USERT0.5, leave BASIC POS-B USERT1; source-defined product0.5.
configuration.direct_full_control: Accepted use1 sets BASIC system and BASIC POS-B USERT1; product1.
configuration.factorfull: Set BASIC system USERT0.5 and BASIC POS-B USERT2; source-defined product1. PAR remains USERT1 at both system and B leaf in every input.

pre_run_hypotheses: Both factorized arms convert with zero errors/reviewed diagnostics and preserve exact populated-table native import/export roundtrips.

Factorhalf reproduces the accepted direct-half control's native event log byte-for-byte and all non-description report tables, and factorfull does the same for the accepted direct-full control. This is a strong bounded multiplication hypothesis; exact equality is tested, not assumed from a shared seed alone.
All runs retain B criticality during BASIC and noncriticality during PAR as their paired controls, with direct CM and 72-bin System/Stock reconciliation.
native_acceptance: Two immutable guarded serial session-0 SSH runs with host-wide mutex, GUI PID13340 identity, registry restoration, frozen accepted source/control fingerprints and 13 raw SHA-256 seals each.
Exact populated-table roundtrips, zero converter errors, reviewed diagnostics, nonempty native outputs, matched event/mission/repair/report comparison and independent read-only replay.
diagnostic_gate: If either equal-product pair diverges in native event log or any non-description report table, or any conversion/roundtrip/source-seal gate fails, retain both arms as diagnostic and revise under a new version/run ID; do not weaken the frozen multiplication hypothesis.
limits: One two-level selected BASIC system-to-POS-B series path, two products 0.5 and 1, one aircraft/seed/replication. No deeper hierarchy, other RBD types, rates, zero usage at the upper level, PM, or population law.

Selected rates and the multiplication interpretation are source/manual/roundtrip bound; the native event log may not print USERT or accumulated operation hours. Exact equality for this seed does not establish a general stochastic coupling, GUI visual behavior or cross-engine parity.
